descriptionChirho: A prophetic oracle or pronouncement, often introduced as a heading for prophetic speech ('the oracle/burden concerning...'); homonym III of massa, distinct from the common noun meaning 'load/burden' (H4853a). Used predominantly in prophetic literature (Isa 13:1, 15:1, 17:1, 19:1, 21:1, 23:1, Nah 1:1, Hab 1:1, Zech 9:1, 12:1, Mal 1:1, etc.). The translation traditions show the dual semantic heritage: English 'oracle/burden,' Spanish 'carga/sentencia,' Arabic وَحْيٌ (revelation) alongside حِمْل (burden), Korean 경고/짐 (warning/burden), Swahili unabii/mzigo (prophecy/burden). All three clusters reflect the same sense with variation only in definiteness and conjunction.
